package.name: diffdrive_teleop
package.description: Joystick teleoperation for DIFFERENTIAL-drive robots: a gamepad maps to drive (linear.x) and turn (angular.z) only. linear.y is never populated, because a differential drive cannot strafe. Deliberately separate from the holonomic X-drive teleop in `revhub` rather than a mode inside it, so neither drive type carries the other's assumptions. Also ships joy_probe, which reads a pad's real axis indices and signs so they need not be guessed.
